E1266

`` `<word>` isn't an active image kind `` (or `` `kind: .<word>` doesn't match this image's `from:` ``).

What

`` `<word>` isn't an active image kind `` (or `` `kind: .<word>` doesn't match this image's `from:` ``).

Why

D-JPK-IMAGE1 + D-JETOS-FREEZE1: active Jetpack images use `.Oci`; `.Iso` disk images are frozen jetos research capture.

Fix

Write `kind: .Oci` for active Jetpack images, or keep `.Iso` only as research capture.
